questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A yellow triangular sign with black lettering means no passing zone. It appears on the left side of two-way, two-lane roads where you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a yield sign is coming. Slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: May turn left or continue straight.
questions.explanation: This sign means your lane is splitting. You can either turn left or drive straight ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians cross at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red and white triangular sign means you must yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
Will always stop at the upcoming railroad crossing.
Should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are approaching a railroad crossing and should prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that railroad tracks are ahead. Look both ways, listen for trains, slow down, and be ready to stop. Do not cross until no trains are coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared to stop if the light is flashing.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A yellow sign showing a traffic signal means a traffic light is coming. Be ready to follow the light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You may see it at intersections with heavy oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that an intersection is coming so you can prepare for traffic or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagonal sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turning on a red signal is prohibited.
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means you cannot turn right or left when the light is red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Wet roads are slippery and dangerous. This sign warns you to slow down because wet pavement makes it harder to stop and easier to lose control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you to watch for a side road intersecting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that the divided highway is ending ahead. Get ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has multiple curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that the number of lanes ahead will decrease. Drivers should merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings indicates a crosswalk ahead. Stay alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turns permitted on a red light.

questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed at this location. It is illegal to turn right here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that a traffic light controls the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road slopes steeply downhill ahead. Check your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will be divided by a barrier or island ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way entrance or exit. If you see this sign ahead, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign is a mandatory rule. Do not pass other vehicles in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns of a curve to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Are traveling in the wrong direction.
Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
May not proceed until it changes to green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must treat the intersection as if it is controlled by a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, then yield to all traffic and pedestrians before proceeding.
